pr_title: Fix multiple tileset layers selection move is broken (fix #3144)
pr_body:
Before this fix, a multi-layer mask movement/scaling (with mixed layer types: normal layer and tilemap layers with different grids) caused loss of drawing areas. The heart of this solution is to correctly align the 'selection mask' and 'transform data' according to the layer's grid, and also, forcing 'site' TilemapMode/TilesetMode before each reproduceAllTransformationsWithInnerCmds() iteration.

Additionally arrow keys now work to move a selected area in TilemapMode::Tiles.

fix aseprite/aseprite#3144

issue_context.title: Multiple tileset layers  selection move is broken
issue_context.body:
Hi all 👋 

I just found out that moving a selection in tileset mode having multiple tileset layers selected leads to loss of information. Only the last selected layers is moved, all the others are cleared (in the selection).

See an example here:
![Screen Recording 2022-01-21 at 13 38 42](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8291084/150528757-379bdd60-67da-4a89-83a6-a2e73e658805.gif)

### Aseprite and System version

* Aseprite version: v1.3-beta10-dev compiled from the release archive
* System: macOS 12.1
